name: tewip
displayName: Tewip - why did my test fail?
description: Finds why each failing test failed (real bug, flaky, environment, test data or changed selector) for any stack, and connects Tewip to your editor's AI assistant.

commands.title: Why did CI fail on this branch?

tewip.path.markdownDescription: How to run Tewip: `tewip` when it is installed from its release file (`npm install -g tewip-<version>.tgz`), or the path to `cli/tewip.ts` (or `dist/cli/tewip.js`) in a checkout.
